# Published source files used in the KeelRace evaluation

## PURE (Ferrari, Spagnolo, Gnesi, RE 2017)
Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.1414117
Local XML (after unzip): `pure-xml/XMLZIPFile/`

Quoted into `reproducibility/eval/cases.mjs`:
- `2008 - keepass.xml` — KeePass Password Safe SRS 1.10
- `1998 - themas.xml` — THEMAS Energy Management SRS
- `0000 - cctns.xml` — CCTNS public requirements

## ArDoCo SAD benchmark (Fuchß et al., ECSA 2022 workshops / 2023 LNCS)
https://github.com/ArDoCo/Benchmark

- `ardoco/teastore.txt` from `teastore/text_2020/teastore.txt`
- `ardoco/jabref.txt` from `jabref/text_2021/jabref.txt`
- `ardoco/teammates.txt` from `teammates/text_2021/teammates.txt`
